intended_object: The inclusion homomorphism U_G(λ)(A) ↪ P_G(λ)(A), from the A-points of the dynamic unipotent subgroup of a cocharacter λ into the A-points of the dynamic parabolic subgroup. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The definition is just Mathlib's `Subgroup.inclusion`, applied to the library's lemma `unipotent_le_parabolic`, which says that `unipotent A l ≤ parabolic A l` as subgroups of the convolution group `WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)`. This is exactly the inclusion homomorphism U(λ)(A) → P(λ)(A). It has the same generality as the subgroups it relates: any commutative semiring R, any Hopf algebra H over R, any commutative R-algebra A and any cocharacter l. The library uses it as the left map of the Levi split extension (`inl_injective` is proved with `Subgroup.inclusion_injective`). There is no missing condition and no unnecessary specialization.
